propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome values with canonical serialization to establish provider-neutral logical-operation contract before adapter implementations
Implement single fake-clock retry-budget owner in reconciler domain to consolidate retry envelope with max three physical invocations and 15-second cumulative sleep
Diagnostic entries must enforce six-key allowlist, apply centralized redaction seam, truncate at 512 code points, and drop excess entries with sentinel overflow marker

Ambiguous writes must observe desired postcondition before replay; observed desired state produces recovered, conclusive old state replays within budget, failed observation produces non-replaying commit_unknown
Retry schedule uses zero-based indexing with additive jitter formula selecting [2s,3s) then [4s,5s) with no third sleep, and authoritative provider delay acts as immovable lower bound
